rules: Headings (Outfit): Use tracking-tight for sizes above 24px. Weights: 500 (Medium) or 700 (Bold). Avoid 400 for headings.
Body (DM Sans): Use leading-relaxed for readability. Weights: 400 (Regular) for text, 500 (Medium) for labels.
Caps: Use uppercase + tracking-widest + text-xs for overlines/labels (e.g., 'PATIENT ID').
Numbers: Use tabular-nums for data/pricing to ensure alignment.

primary.name: Teal
primary.usage: Primary Actions, Active States, Brand Identity

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode First. Use 'Sand' (#F5F5F4) as the main app background to reduce clinical harshness. Use White (#FFFFFF) for content cards to create lift.
colors.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle mesh gradients in 'Teal' and 'Sand' for Hero sections only.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid (Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Mix square and rectangular widgets.
grid_system.lists: Clean Rows. No heavy borders. Use border-b only.
grid_system.mobile: Single column. Bottom Navigation for primary app sections.

layout.radius: Rounded-xl (12px) or Rounded-2xl (16px) for a friendly, approachable feel.

buttons.interaction: Scale down slightly on click (active:scale-95). Hover: Lift slightly.

cards.style: Flat White with subtle shadow (shadow-sm). Border-border/50.

inputs.style: Filled 'Sand' background (bg-secondary) with bottom border focus, OR standard outlined with generous padding.

navigation.desktop: Sidebar or Top Header with clear hierarchy.

assets.icons: Use Lucide-React (default). For medical specifics, ensure clarity.

universal_guidelines: Do not use purple or teal for CTAs indiscriminately. Use the defined Primary Teal.
Avoid center-aligned text for long content.
Use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling if possible.
Glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with a white/70 background for overlays.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Nevika Cura' dashboard using the Bento Grid layout. Use the provided images for the respective sections (Doctor booking, Pharmacy, Lab). Ensure the 'Sand' background is used to differentiate from the white cards. Focus on the 'Mobile-First' experience.
